protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed independently from the pre-fix code and direct fix: linked_circuit_closed() removes the last leg from the linked pool but retains circ->conflux; unlinked_get_or_create() lets a recovery leg share that same object; try_finalize_set() revives it and gives the recovery circuit a second owning pointer; later reap can free then dereference/free the object again. The vendor ChangeLog, changes/bug41306, CVE.org record, and regression test all identify the same UAF/double-free crash mechanism.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 336a24754d117b46793ce6824e35ff6b7962bf9d. Blame at the pre-fix last-leg retention, recovery sharing, revival, and free-time transfer lines resolves to this commit. It is the single-parent first public write of the newly added src/core/or/conflux_pool.c and contains all interacting lifetime rules; its parent has no version of that file.
